description: Complete FINAL two commuting binary lamp-copy linear game; shared c=-1
source_relations: a_i^2=b_i^2=c^2=1, a_i b_i c=1, y_i a_i y_i^-1=b_i, y_i b_i y_i^-1=a_i, x_i y_i x_i^-1=y_i^2; all cross-copy generator commutators; c central and c=-1

game_rule.distribution: choose row uniformly, then its incident variable uniformly
game_rule.alice_answer: one sign per row variable, with product row[0]
game_rule.win: Alice sign at queried incidence equals Bob sign

recipe_language.L: [L,p,entries]: row i has signed source word entries[i] at column p[i]
recipe_language.index_rule: All operands precede their node. Source word negative integers denote adjoints; products read left to right.

lower_recovery.recipe: P=(1-parity)/2, P_i=(1-W_i)/2, Q_i=P P_i product_(j in half,j<i)(1-P_j); H_s=sum_i Q_i (g_i original_word(s) g_i*) Q_i; F_s=H_s+flip H_s flip
